nodes.title: The voice runtime's full per-sentence safety check (AI-affirmation check, reply door, and the join with the previous sentence) takes p50 2.21 ms, p95 4.67 ms, p99 5.64 ms and max 17.7 ms on the coding sandbox; a 2,000-character adversarial line takes 35-47 ms.
nodes.method: Python 3.13 on the 4-vCPU coding sandbox; rules.json at 70a661c; every cases.json replyDoor input x5, each with the previous input as the prev sentence so the join always runs; the contract door alone is p50 0.57 / p99 1.47 ms. Not measured: the deployed host, or many calls on one process.
nodes.value: p99 5.64 ms per sentence (negligible against 0.7-2 s reply gaps)
